title: Speaking — Cooking at home
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on cooking at home.

questions: What places are within walking distance of your home?
When are the streets near your home most lively?
Which part of the area would you show to a visitor?
What is an easy dish you often prepare?
Who normally cooks where you live?

part2.topic: Describe a dish someone taught you to make.
points: what part took the most practice
part2.closing: and explain when you would make it again.

questions: Why are some cooking traditions passed down more successfully than others?
Should students learn to plan affordable meals at school?
How has everyday life connected with cooking at home changed for people of different ages?
